413-1339-7920.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
413-1339-7920.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Tresserhorn's Lord triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

2464-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites:
Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
2464-4687-5115.description:
Activate Song of Freyalise by tapping Gilder Bairn, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-728-5173-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Shambling Ghast from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, exiling Shambling Ghast from the top of your library with the ability to cast it until your next turn.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Shambling Ghast from exile by paying {1}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

290-1999-4613-7340.easyPrerequisites: Master Transmuter does not have summoning sickness.
290-1999-4613-7340.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding at least two mana which you can spend to activate Master Transmuter due to Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Dreamstone Hedron from the battlefield to your hand, putting Sewer-veillance Cam from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Activate Master Transmuter by paying {U}, tapping it, and returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand, putting Dreamstone Hedron from your hand onto the vattlefield.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, allowing you to untap Master Transmuter.
Repeat.

2793-3365-3743-5089-7824.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3365-3743-5089-7824.description:
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3457-5434-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

240-2079-4050-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3497-7182-7252.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 4 life this turn.
3497-7182-7252.description:
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-1849-3129-3899.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3480-4091-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Aphetto Alchemist.
Activate one of the Aphetto Alchemist tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Aphetto Alchemist token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1170-5078-6595-6979.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell using The Fourth Doctor this turn If Sensei's Divining Top is on top of your library.
1170-5078-6595-6979.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten and Lyse Hext trigger, and The Fourth Doctor triggers if you had cast Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking The Fourth Doctor.
Resolve the Fourth Doctor trigger, if applicable, creating a Food token.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

549-856-2438-6748-6757.description:
Cast Cauldron Familiar by paying {B}.
When Cauldron Familiar enters, it and Weapons Manufacturing trigger.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Weapons Manufacturing trigger, creating a Munitions artifact token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing the Munitions, as it is a Food due to Ragost.
The Munitions triggers, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1636-5463-5914.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken non-Faerie creature with greater mana value than Nurturing Pixie that can be cast using only mana creatures you control can produce.
1636-5463-5914.description:
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Nurturing Pixie.
Cast Nurturing Pixie by paying its mana cost.
When Nurturing Pixie enters the battlefield, it, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Nurturing Pixie trigger, returning the other creature with greater mana value from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate any number of creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast the creature returned to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Clement and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Clement trigger, returning Nurturing Pixie from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-5463-5914.notes: You can tap Frogs for mana thanks to Clement. This should be factored in when determining if you have enough mana to execute the combo.

147-997-6476.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{R} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
147-997-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

101-4871-5231-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
101-4871-5231-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Vampire Charmseeker and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Vampire Charmseeker, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1069-4763-5004-6068.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts, including an Equipment except Dissection Tools.
1069-4763-5004-6068.description:
Activate an equipment except Dissection Tools' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Cathodion.
Activate Dissection Tools by sacrificing Cathodion, targeting Koll.
When Cathodion dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Dissection Tools ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Cathodion by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

428-1694-3769-5362.notablePrerequisites:
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
You have a way to deal exactly two or three damage to an opponent.
You have enough mana to cast Quantum Misalignment.
428-1694-3769-5362.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim. Blim triggers, giving control of Gisela to an opponent.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal exactly two or three damage to the opponent, which is reduced to one by Gisela, triggering Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn's trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.exileCardState: with a takeover counter on it

1912-3719-4753-5326.notablePrerequisites: Clever Impersonator has a power of at least 2.
1912-3719-4753-5326.description:
Cast The Master by paying {U}{B}.
When The Master enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Clever Impersonator and create at least two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate The Master by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Clever Impersonator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of The Master, which causes the Clever Impersonator to be a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
When Clever Impersonator enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice The Master and create two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Clever Impersonator by paying {B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning The Master from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Ruthless Technomancer.
Repeat from step 2.

957-2061-4477.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the Greenwarden of Murasa token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Stretch from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat during your second turn.

1652-4939-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning Burning-Tree Emissary from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Burning-Tree Emissary enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{G}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Burning-Tree Emissary and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

1980-2845-3556-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1980-2845-3556-4423.description:
Cast Flicker by paying {1}{W}, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the copy of Flicker, blinking Quintorius Kand.
Resolve the original Flicker, blinking Mystic Sanctuary.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting Flicker on top of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Quintorius Kand's second loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, causing you to exile Flicker from the top of your library and cast it without paying its mana cost, targeting Mystic Sanctuary.
Quintorius Kand and Swarm Intelligence trigger.
Resolve the Quintorius Kand trigger, dealing 2 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Swarm Intelligence trigger, copying Flicker targeting Quintorius Kand.
Repeat from step 3.

49-1799-3621-5147.notablePrerequisites: Grenzo has a power of eight or greater.
49-1799-3621-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Su-Chi Cave Guard into your graveyard from the bottom of your library, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1189-1692-1965.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a colorless creature you control.
1189-1692-1965.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Omarthis with haste.
Put a +1/+1 counter on the Omarthis token or another colorless creature you control.
The nontoken Omarthis triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
The Omarthis token triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 3.

513-2792-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
513-2792-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Palinchron by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Great Whale to your hand from the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Palinchron to your hand from the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control a land that can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana.

856-4231-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1256-2757-3430.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Jade Mage by paying {2}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling, untapping the basic land.
Repeat.

474-1056-2034.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least two opponents.
You have an additional card in your graveyard for each opponent you have.
Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
474-1056-2034.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling a number of cards equal to the number of opponent you have, giving Specimen Collector encore until end of turn.
Activate Specimen Collector's encore ability by paying {4}{U} and exiling it, creating at least two token copies of it with haste.
Each Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, creating that many 1/1 Squirrel and 0/3 Crab creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Specimen Collector token, adding {C}{C}.
The Specimen Collector token dies, creating a token copy of a Specimen Collector token.
Repeat from step 3.

1525-2372-3063-3819.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least ten Gates with different names on the battlefield, in hand and/or in library.
You have a land card in hand.
1525-2372-3063-3819.description:
Cast Cultivator Colossus by paying {4}{G}{G}{G}.
Cultivator Colossus enters the battlefield, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped, then revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card, putting it in your hand and the rest of the revealed cards on the bottom of your library in any order.
Repeat this process, putting a land card from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat step 3 until you have Maze's End and ten Gates with different names on the battlefield.
Move to your end step.
At the beginning of your end step, Wilderness Reclamation triggers, untapping all lands you control.
Activate three of the Gates by tapping them, adding {3}.
Activate Maze's End's second ability by paying {3}, tapping it and returning Maze's End to your hand, causing you to win the game.

614-1987-2510-3941.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
614-1987-2510-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Nucklavee, blinking them.
When Nucklavee enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
